allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Officer Chan Ka Kui manages to put a major Hong Kong drug dealer behind the bars practically alone, after a shooting and an impressive chase inside a slum. Now, he must protect the boss' secretary, Selina, who will testify against the gangster in court.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Chan managed to bring down the crime boss virtually alone, but keeping his star witness safe long enough to reach the courtroom proves even more volatile.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After single-handedly arresting a major drug lord following a chaotic chase through a hillside slum, Hong Kong police officer Chan Ka Kui is assigned to guard the kingpin's key witness, his secretary Selina.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and exciting with moderate crime stakes, balancing high-impact action and lighthearted comic energy.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Jackie Chan, this energetic blend of crime thriller, physical comedy, and kinetic stunt work delivers relentless momentum and suspenseful witness-protection stakes.
